description: I Knew You Were Trouble. She tried dubstep. DUBSTEP. In 2012. That's like me putting a trap beat under a love song, which I did do, but I did it FIRST and BETTER. This one's fine, the drop is kind of fun, but it's a novelty. She heard Skrillex once and said 'I can do that.' You can't. I'm the one who breaks genre rules around here.
